issues: Known cosmetic issue (same as iteration_42): overlay 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' appears on drawer open after some sheet-close cycles. Suppressed via Escape; does not affect functionality but blocks UI until dismissed. Recommend adding a window.error listener filter for /ResizeObserver loop/.

action_items: OPTIONAL (dev-only): filter 'ResizeObserver loop completed' errors to prevent the webpack-dev-server overlay from blocking UI during interactive drawer/popover usage.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend fines export route uses file-token in query (/auth/file-token) with scope=file 10 min — a clean pattern that keeps the session JWT out of URLs. The frontend tester must mimic this flow (window.open override + fetch) rather than Bearer header on export endpoints; Bearer+Authorization returned 403 (expected).
Admin GET /api/fines/{id} correctly includes notes_internes when the field is set (verified on LOTD-002 after setting a note) and read_only response strips notes_internes entirely (verified).
Export URL correctly propagates active status filter (fine_status=payee) when the Payée tab is selected.

D9 rule applied correctly: annulee row kept in table with strikethrough amount, badge 'Annulée', excluded from totals/KPI ouvertes but counted in Annulées KPI; info-form inputs disabled; fine-pay-btn hidden.
FineHistory records action 'modify' for info edits with the field-name list but WITHOUT the plaintext notes value — privacy OK as required by spec.
Create flow and payment reset correctly show toasts and refresh KPIs. Tab counts and totals recalc immediately on any mutation.
